bundle.shortDescription: Synology shared folders on Linux over SSHFS
bundle.longDescription: Guided setup of SSHFS mounts for Synology NAS: SSH key, pinned host key, mounts at login, reconnect after suspend and network changes, LAN and internet addresses, and a self-test of what each folder can do. Independent community project, not affiliated with Synology Inc.
